subject: STAT101
filterSummary: Successfully selected 10 videos, one for each of the 5 topics in both English and Arabic. The chosen videos are highly relevant, popular, and directly address the specified student learning challenges, from the conceptual nature of CLT and Sampling Distributions to the practical application of Z-scores and data transformations. All hard gates were applied, and no topic was left uncovered.

coverage.note: Video [174] was also highly relevant but already selected for another topic.

videos.title: The Central Limit Theorem, Clearly Explained!!!
videos.filter_reason: This highly popular StatQuest video uses excellent animations to visually demonstrate how the distribution of sample means tends to normality, directly addressing the core conceptual hurdle for students.

videos.title: Sampling Distributions (7.2)
videos.filter_reason: This video excels at making the abstract concept of a sampling distribution concrete by visually contrasting it with a sample distribution and building it up from multiple samples.

videos.title: Normal Distribution Word Problems
videos.filter_reason: This video focuses specifically on solving word problems by walking through the entire process: translating the problem, calculating the Z-score, using the table, and interpreting the final probability.

videos.title: What is an unbiased estimator? Proof sample mean is unbiased and why we divide by n-1 for sample var
videos.filter_reason: This video provides the necessary theoretical foundation by proving that the sample mean is an unbiased estimator and explaining exactly why the sample variance formula divides by n-1.

videos.title: Data Transformation for Positively and Negatively Skewed Distributions in SPSS
videos.filter_reason: This comprehensive guide directly addresses the student's struggle by demonstrating how to identify both positive and negative skewness and then apply the appropriate transformation (e.g., log, square root, reflect).

videos.title: الإحصاء - الباب الرابع (توزيعات المعاينة) - نظرية النهاية المركزية (3)
videos.filter_reason: A concise and highly-viewed video that clearly explains the Central Limit Theorem within the context of sampling distributions, making it a perfect and accessible introduction.

videos.title: الاحصاء - الباب الرابع (توزيعات المعاينة) - جزئية النظري (1)
videos.filter_reason: This is a very popular and concise introduction to the theory of sampling distributions, providing a strong and clear foundation for this abstract topic.

videos.title: Normal Distribution شرح
videos.filter_reason: With over 230k views, this is a very popular and comprehensive lesson that explains standardization and the use of Z-tables to solve probability problems from start to finish.

videos.title: الاحتمالات والإحصاء الرياضي/خصائص المقدر الجيد| خاصية عدم التحيز (الانحياز) unbiased ness/محاضرة(37)
videos.filter_reason: This is a popular and thorough academic lecture that covers the properties of good estimators, focusing on the concept of unbiasedness with the necessary mathematical proofs.

videos.title: درس معالجة التوزيع غير الطبيعي للبيانات
videos.filter_reason: This popular and direct video explains how to handle non-normal data by identifying the type of skewness and applying the correct transformation, which is the core difficulty for students.
